description: Redux reducer module for managing file-related state in Mattermost, including handling file uploads, post attachments, bookmarks, search results, file links, and rejected downloads.

methods.name: files
methods.description: Reducer for managing the collection of files, handling actions related to file uploads, post attachments, bookmarks, and logout.

methods.name: filesFromSearch
methods.description: Reducer for managing files resulting from search queries.

methods.name: storeAllFilesForPost
methods.description: Helper function to process embedded files and store files for a post.

methods.name: storeFilesForPost
methods.description: Stores files associated with a specific post into the state.

methods.name: fileIdsByPostId
methods.description: Reducer for mapping post IDs to their associated file IDs.

methods.name: storeFilesIdsForPost
methods.description: Helper to store file IDs for a specific post.

methods.name: filePublicLink
methods.description: Reducer managing the public link for a file.

methods.name: rejectedFiles
methods.description: Reducer tracking files that failed to download.
